name: モーションブラー整合性
description: Detects inconsistent motion blur patterns in AI-generated videos.
useCase: Identifying fake videos through motion blur analysis
mechanism: Analyzes directional blur anisotropy across blocks. Real camera motion creates consistent directional blur, while AI-generated frames often lack this natural property.
source: Verdoliva (2020) - Media Forensics and DeepFakes, IEEE SPM
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Verdoliva (2020) - Media Forensics and DeepFakes, IEEE SPM
